'''Dalicia Sweetsilver''', nicknamed '''Dal''', is a [[high elf]] [[quest giver]] located in [[Brinthilien]] in the [[Thalassian Highlands]]. A cook, she had been involved with the resettlement of the Highlands and the restoration of the outpost of [[Alah'Thalas]] since its very beginnings, putting her culinary skills to use to feed the laborers and refugees.<ref name="ThalassianGoulash" />
